questions.question:
**Direction: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.**

Desert
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"Populate."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "Desert" means to leave somebody/something, usually for ever. (किसी को (प्रायः सदा के लिए) छोड़ जाना)
 
 
• Example: *Many people have **deserted**__ the countryside and moved to the towns.*
 
 
 
• The word that is opposite in meaning to the given word is "populate."
 
• The word "Populate" means to fill a particular area with people. (किसी स्‍थान में आबादी होना)
 __
 
• Example: *Parts of the country are very thinly **populated**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Bereft: **completely lacking something; having lost something. (पूर्णतया रहित; से हीन या वंचित)
 
• **Forlorn: **lonely and unhappy; not cared for. (अकेला और उदास; उपेक्षित)
 
• **Migrate: **(used about a large number of people) to go and live and work in another place. ((बड़ी संख्‍या में लोगों का) अन्‍य स्‍थान पर जाना, वहाँ रहना और काम करना)

questions.question:
**Direction: In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one that best expresses the meaning of the idiom or phrase.**

A blessing in disguise

options.text: To have a dispute with someone
Hear a good news after a long time
A misfortune that unexpectedly turns into good fortune
To go from being very poor to being very wealthy

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"A misfortune that unexpectedly turns into good fortune."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The phrase **"a blessing in disguise"** refers to a situation that seems to be unfortunate or negative at first but eventually turns out to have positive or beneficial aspects that may not have been immediately apparent. (ऐसी स्थिति जो पहले तो दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण या नकारात्मक प्रतीत होती है लेकिन अंततः उसके सकारात्मक या लाभकारी पहलू सामने आते हैं जो शायद तुरंत स्पष्ट नहीं होते)
 
• In other words, it suggests that something initially perceived as a setback or misfortune ultimately leads to unexpected advantages or positive outcomes. 
 
• It emphasizes the idea that sometimes challenges or difficulties can bring about hidden opportunities or silver linings.
 
 
• **Example**:* **Losing my job turned out to be **a blessing in disguise**__, as it led me to discover a more fulfilling career path.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

questions.solution:

__
 
• The error in the sentence is a subject-verb agreement issue.
 
• The reason to use **"is" **instead of **"are"** is to ensure subject-verb agreement.

**Correct sentence**: *I am thirty-two years old, and **my sister is fifteen**__. *
